    // The tuple with every component negated.
    Negative(value: Number4): Number4
        => (-value.X, -value.Y, -value.Z, -value.W);

    // The dot product: the sum of the products of corresponding components.
    Dot(self: Number4, right: Number4): Number
        => self.X * right.X + self.Y * right.Y + self.Z * right.Z + self.W * right.W;

    // Each component restricted to the corresponding [min, max] range.
    // Precondition: min <= max component-wise.
    Clamp(self: Number4, min: Number4, max: Number4): Number4
        => (self.X.Clamp(min.X, max.X),
                   self.Y.Clamp(min.Y, max.Y),
                   self.Z.Clamp(min.Z, max.Z),
                   self.W.Clamp(min.W, max.W));

    // The component-wise maximum.
    Max(self: Number4, value2: Number4): Number4
        => (self.X.Max(value2.X), self.Y.Max(value2.Y),
                   self.Z.Max(value2.Z), self.W.Max(value2.W));

    // The component-wise minimum.
    Min(self: Number4, value2: Number4): Number4
        => (self.X.Min(value2.X), self.Y.Min(value2.Y),
                   self.Z.Min(value2.Z), self.W.Min(value2.W));

    // The IHashable obligation: every component folded into one digest.
    Hash(self: Number4): Integer
        => self.X.Hash.CombineHash(self.Y.Hash).CombineHash(self.Z.Hash).CombineHash(self.W.Hash);

    //==
    // # Number4 — homogeneous transforms
    //
    // Row-vector convention: v' = v M, so component j of the result pairs the
    // whole of v with COLUMN j of the matrix (Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md -
    // Matrices). Rows are Number4, so M(i,j) is Row<i>.<j-th field>: M11 is
    // Row1.X, M21 is Row2.X, and so on.

    // The 4-vector carried through a 4x4 transform, treating it as a homogeneous
    // coordinate: no perspective divide, W is produced by the fourth column.
    Transform(self: Number4, matrix: Matrix4x4): Number4
        => (
            self.X * matrix.Row1.X + self.Y * matrix.Row2.X + self.Z * matrix.Row3.X + self.W * matrix.Row4.X,
            self.X * matrix.Row1.Y + self.Y * matrix.Row2.Y + self.Z * matrix.Row3.Y + self.W * matrix.Row4.Y,
            self.X * matrix.Row1.Z + self.Y * matrix.Row2.Z + self.Z * matrix.Row3.Z + self.W * matrix.Row4.Z,
            self.X * matrix.Row1.W + self.Y * matrix.Row2.W + self.Z * matrix.Row3.W + self.W * matrix.Row4.W);

    // Operator spelling of the transform above, with the matrix on the left.
    // The argument order is the historical `M * v` reading; the computation is
    // still the row-vector product v M.
    Multiply(matrix: Matrix4x4, self: Number4): Number4
        => self.Transform(matrix);

    // The 4-vector whose XYZ part is rotated by a unit quaternion, with W passed
    // through untouched. The coefficients are the quaternion-to-matrix identity
    // written inline (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quaternions_and_spatial_rotation),
    // matching System.Numerics term for term.
    Transform(self: Number4, rotation: Quaternion): Number4
    {
        var x2 = rotation.X + rotation.X;
        var y2 = rotation.Y + rotation.Y;
        var z2 = rotation.Z + rotation.Z;
        var wx2 = rotation.W * x2;
        var wy2 = rotation.W * y2;
        var wz2 = rotation.W * z2;
        var xx2 = rotation.X * x2;
        var xy2 = rotation.X * y2;
        var xz2 = rotation.X * z2;
        var yy2 = rotation.Y * y2;
        var yz2 = rotation.Y * z2;
        var zz2 = rotation.Z * z2;
        return (
            self.X * (1.0 - yy2 - zz2) + self.Y * (xy2 - wz2) + self.Z * (xz2 + wy2),
            self.X * (xy2 + wz2) + self.Y * (1.0 - xx2 - zz2) + self.Z * (yz2 - wx2),
            self.X * (xz2 - wy2) + self.Y * (yz2 + wx2) + self.Z * (1.0 - xx2 - yy2),
            self.W);
    }

    // Operator spelling of the quaternion rotation above, rotation on the left.
    Multiply(rotation: Quaternion, self: Number4): Number4
        => self.Transform(rotation);

    //==
    // # Number8
    //
    // Eight independent lanes: every operation below is lane-wise, with no
    // horizontal mixing except Dot, which sums all eight products.

    // Lane-wise sum.
    Add(left: Number8, right: Number8): Number8
        => (left.X0 + right.X0, left.X1 + right.X1, left.X2 + right.X2, left.X3 + right.X3,
                   left.X4 + right.X4, left.X5 + right.X5, left.X6 + right.X6, left.X7 + right.X7);

    // Lane-wise difference.
    Subtract(left: Number8, right: Number8): Number8
        => (left.X0 - right.X0, left.X1 - right.X1, left.X2 - right.X2, left.X3 - right.X3,
                   left.X4 - right.X4, left.X5 - right.X5, left.X6 - right.X6, left.X7 - right.X7);

    // Lane-wise product.
    Multiply(left: Number8, right: Number8): Number8
        => (left.X0 * right.X0, left.X1 * right.X1, left.X2 * right.X2, left.X3 * right.X3,
                   left.X4 * right.X4, left.X5 * right.X5, left.X6 * right.X6, left.X7 * right.X7);

    // Every lane scaled by a scalar.
    Multiply(left: Number8, scalar: Number): Number8
        => (left.X0 * scalar, left.X1 * scalar, left.X2 * scalar, left.X3 * scalar,
                   left.X4 * scalar, left.X5 * scalar, left.X6 * scalar, left.X7 * scalar);

    // Every lane scaled by a scalar, scalar on the left.
    Multiply(scalar: Number, right: Number8): Number8
        => (scalar * right.X0, scalar * right.X1, scalar * right.X2, scalar * right.X3,
                   scalar * right.X4, scalar * right.X5, scalar * right.X6, scalar * right.X7);

    // Lane-wise quotient. Precondition: no lane of right is zero.
    Divide(left: Number8, right: Number8): Number8
        => (left.X0 / right.X0, left.X1 / right.X1, left.X2 / right.X2, left.X3 / right.X3,
                   left.X4 / right.X4, left.X5 / right.X5, left.X6 / right.X6, left.X7 / right.X7);

    // Every lane divided by a scalar. Precondition: scalar is non-zero.
    Divide(left: Number8, scalar: Number): Number8
        => (left.X0 / scalar, left.X1 / scalar, left.X2 / scalar, left.X3 / scalar,
                   left.X4 / scalar, left.X5 / scalar, left.X6 / scalar, left.X7 / scalar);

    // The tuple with every lane negated.
    Negative(value: Number8): Number8
        => (-value.X0, -value.X1, -value.X2, -value.X3,
                   -value.X4, -value.X5, -value.X6, -value.X7);

    // Lane-wise absolute value.
    Abs(self: Number8): Number8
        => (self.X0.Abs, self.X1.Abs, self.X2.Abs, self.X3.Abs,
                   self.X4.Abs, self.X5.Abs, self.X6.Abs, self.X7.Abs);

    // Lane-wise square root. Precondition: no lane is negative.
    Sqrt(self: Number8): Number8
        => (self.X0.Sqrt, self.X1.Sqrt, self.X2.Sqrt, self.X3.Sqrt,
                   self.X4.Sqrt, self.X5.Sqrt, self.X6.Sqrt, self.X7.Sqrt);

    // The dot product: the sum of the products of corresponding lanes.
    Dot(self: Number8, right: Number8): Number
        => self.X0 * right.X0 + self.X1 * right.X1 + self.X2 * right.X2 + self.X3 * right.X3
         + self.X4 * right.X4 + self.X5 * right.X5 + self.X6 * right.X6 + self.X7 * right.X7;

    // The lane-wise maximum.
    Max(self: Number8, value2: Number8): Number8
        => (self.X0.Max(value2.X0), self.X1.Max(value2.X1),
                   self.X2.Max(value2.X2), self.X3.Max(value2.X3),
                   self.X4.Max(value2.X4), self.X5.Max(value2.X5),
                   self.X6.Max(value2.X6), self.X7.Max(value2.X7));

    // The lane-wise minimum.
    Min(self: Number8, value2: Number8): Number8
        => (self.X0.Min(value2.X0), self.X1.Min(value2.X1),
                   self.X2.Min(value2.X2), self.X3.Min(value2.X3),
                   self.X4.Min(value2.X4), self.X5.Min(value2.X5),
                   self.X6.Min(value2.X6), self.X7.Min(value2.X7));
